post.subtitle:
How do distributed NoSQL databases keep data consistent across multiple servers worldwide without bringing your application to a crawl? 🛠️

Learn how to master Consistency Handling in NoSQL Explained in this quick breakdown.

📖 Read the full guide here:
https://www.abstractalgorithms.dev/

In this Short:
- How do distributed NoSQL databases maintain consistency across worldwide servers?
- NoSQL databases choose between immediate consistency or high availability and low latency.
- Eventual consistency uses quorum writes and reads to achieve agreement.
- Conflicts are resolved using Last-Write-Wins or Conflict-Free Replicated Data Types.
